entity.name: Elon Musk
entity.domain: Technology, space exploration, electric vehicles, social media
facts: CEO of Tesla, the world's most valuable automaker
Founder and CEO of SpaceX, first private company to send humans to the ISS
Acquired Twitter in 2022 and rebranded it to X
Founded The Boring Company for tunnel infrastructure
Co-founded OpenAI in 2015, later departed and became a vocal critic
Born in Pretoria, South Africa; moved to the US via Canada
Made early fortune from Zip2 and PayPal (X.com merger)
Became richest person in the world in 2021
Known for ambitious timelines that frequently slip (e.g., Full Self-Driving, Mars colonisation)
Father of multiple children with multiple partners
Appointed to lead the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) in 2025
Frequently posts controversial opinions and memes on X
SpaceX developed reusable Falcon 9 rockets and the Starship programme
Tesla produces Model S, 3, X, Y, Cybertruck, and Semi
Advocates for multi-planetary civilisation and Mars colonisation
Criticised for labour practices at Tesla and SpaceX
Major donor and political figure in the 2024 US election cycle
